issue.title: AgentCore Harness Creation Fails with "Provider produced inconsistent result after apply"
issue.body:
### Terraform and AWS Provider Version

```console
Used cached hashicorp/template v2.2.0
Used cached hashicorp/aws v6.58.0
```

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

Resource: aws_bedrockagentcore_harness  [Harness Definition](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/resources/bedrockagentcore_harness)

### Expected Behavior

I would expect that it will generate the listed outputs; the harness ARNs

### Actual Behavior

 Error: Provider produced inconsistent result after apply
